mistakes.text: He should buy the shirt one size bigger.
mistakes.normalized: he should buy the shirt one size bigger
mistakes.feedback_sk: Výčitka za minulosť potrebuje „should have“ + tretí tvar: „should have bought“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Výčitka za minulost potřebuje „should have“ + příčestí minulé: „should have bought“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Criticism about the past needs “should have” + past participle: “should have bought”.

mistakes.text: He should have buy the shirt one size bigger.
mistakes.normalized: he should have buy the shirt one size bigger
mistakes.feedback_en: After “should have” use the past participle: “bought”.

mistakes.text: He should had bought the shirt one size bigger.
mistakes.normalized: he should had bought the shirt one size bigger
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po modálnom slovese je vždy „have“, nie „had“: „should have bought“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po modálním slovese je vždy „have“, ne „had“: „should have bought“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After a modal verb always use “have”, not “had”: “should have bought”.

mistakes.text: He had to buy the shirt one size bigger.
mistakes.normalized: he had to buy the shirt one size bigger
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Had to“ znamená musel. „Mal si kúpiť“ (ale nekúpil) je „should have bought“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Had to“ znamená musel. „Měl si koupit“ (ale nekoupil) je „should have bought“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Had to” means it was necessary; for advice he didn't follow use “should have bought”.

mistakes.text: He should have bought the shirt one number bigger.
mistakes.normalized: he should have bought the shirt one number bigger
mistakes.feedback_sk: Veľkosť oblečenia je „size“, nie „number“: „one size bigger“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Velikost oblečení je „size“, ne „number“: „one size bigger“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For clothes, English uses “size”, not “number”: “one size bigger”.

mistakes.text: He ought to have bought the shirt one size bigger.
mistakes.normalized: he ought to have bought the shirt one size bigger
mistakes.feedback_sk: Význam sedí, no cvičí sa „should have“: „should have bought“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Význam sedí, ale procvičuje se „should have“: „should have bought“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Same meaning, but this exercise practises “should have”: “should have bought”.
